input: Research Carvana (carvana.com) for a hedge fund

catalysts.claim: Funding renewal: a $600 million finance-receivable facility matures on 2027-02-14; terms as_of 2026-09-30.
Funding renewal: another $600 million finance-receivable facility matures on 2027-03-29; terms as_of 2026-09-30.
Debt repayment: $32 million of 5.5% unsecured notes mature on 2027-04-15; principal outstanding as_of 2026-09-30.
Inventory funding: the $1.5 billion floorplan commitment expires on 2027-04-30; terms as_of 2026-09-30.
The Q4 2026 earnings call will introduce withdrawal of quarterly and annual financial outlooks, according to management's announcement as_of 2026-10-28. The call's calendar date was not verified.

results_vs_guidance.claim: Latest reported quarter, ended 2026-09-30: retail units 217,385, revenue $8.040 billion, net income $483 million, adjusted EBITDA $800 million, and GAAP operating income $714 million. Retail units increased 39% year over year; revenue increased 42%.

Prior guidance as_of 2026-07-29 called for sequential Q3 retail-unit growth from Q2's 197,325 units and full-year adjusted EBITDA of $2.7–$3.0 billion. The subsequently reported Q3 unit figure cleared that qualitative growth hurdle.

Against MarketBeat's earnings-day consensus for Q3 ended 2026-09-30, revenue of $8.04 billion exceeded $7.71 billion expected, while reported EPS of $0.39 missed approximately $0.44 expected. Consensus is provider-specific.

Current guidance as_of 2026-10-28: sequential retail-unit growth in Q4 and full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA toward the higher end of the previously communicated $2.7–$3.0 billion range, conditional on a stable environment.

Reporting-policy change announced as_of 2026-10-28: management plans to emphasize GAAP profitability metrics in 2027 and cease quarterly/annual financial outlooks beginning with the Q4 2026 earnings call.

event_driven.claim: By 2026-09-30, Carvana had fully redeemed its 2030 secured notes using term-loan proceeds and cash.

Shareholder transaction, not issuer financing: on 2026-10-30, Garcia-controlled ECG II SPE II sold Citibank covered calls over 10,000,000 Carvana shares at $90, exercisable only on 2027-11-19 and physically settled. Disclosed as_of 2026-11-03; expiry is outside this brief's near-term catalyst window.

credit_signals.claim: Liquidity as_of 2026-09-30: cash $3.049 billion; collateral-supported revolving availability $2.071 billion; committed liquidity $5.120 billion. Management's broader $7.503 billion liquidity measure also includes debt-incurrence capacity and unpledged securitization interests, so it is not equivalent to cash or committed funding.
Debt excluding finance leases totaled $5.161 billion; Carvana reported compliance with all debt covenants as_of 2026-09-30.

Financing terms as_of 2026-08-14: the $1.66 billion Term Loan B matures 2033-08-14, carries a Term SOFR option plus 2.25%, and has no financial covenant. Restrictions on indebtedness, liens, restricted payments, and affiliate transactions remain.

Management estimated as_of 2026-08-12 that replacing the secured notes with the term loan would reduce cash interest expense by approximately $45 million annually over the following four years. This is a company estimate, not verified realized savings.

alternative_signals.claim: Pricing signal as_of Q3 ended 2026-09-30: management said customer loan rates had been lowered by more than 100 basis points relative to benchmarks over the preceding two years. This is company-reported, not an independent channel check.

Capacity/hiring signal as_of 2026-09-01: Carvana announced reconditioning integration at its existing Sacramento-area auction site, said hiring had begun, and projected approximately 100 additional jobs over time. The announcement does not establish completed hiring.

As_of 2026-11-10, Carvana's inspection-center careers page advertises technician, detailing, and body/paint career tracks. The opened page did not expose a verified vacancy count; it cannot establish net headcount growth.

Financing-policy clarification as_of 2026-11-09: Carvana says it has no minimum credit-score requirement, but its advertised 99% approval rate applies only to eligible customers satisfying specified information, payment, and underwriting conditions—not all applicants.

insider_and_ownership.claim: Form 4 filed 2026-11-05: director Ira Platt exercised and sold 15,000 shares at a weighted-average $74.32 and another 14,640 at $77.21 on 2026-11-04. Exercise price was $3; direct shares remaining were 186,470. These were sales following option exercises, not insider purchases.

Schedule 13D/A filed 2026-11-03 reported Ernest Garcia II beneficially owning 212,211,585 Class A-equivalent shares, or 22.7%, as_of 2026-10-30. This includes controlled entities and assumes conversion of his LLC units; it is not simply an outstanding-share voting percentage.

Capital Research Global Investors disclosed 63,427,023 shares and an 8.9% stake as_of 2026-06-30 in its amended Schedule 13G. This is a lagged ownership observation, not a current trading-position estimate.

The filing-history table shows Capital Research Global Investors' reported percentage rising from 7.6% as_of 2026-03-31 to 8.9% as_of 2026-06-30. This percentage comparison does not establish its subsequent trading activity.

risks.claim: Margin compression could undermine the growth thesis: for Q3 ended 2026-09-30, adjusted EBITDA margin was 10.0% versus 11.3% a year earlier, despite substantial unit growth.
Earnings sensitivity: Q3 loan-sale gains were $381 million; lower loan-sale spreads partly offset volume growth, as_of 2026-09-30.
Collateral risk: $427 million of securitization interests were pledged to repurchase financing; declining collateral values increase repurchase prices, as_of 2026-09-30.
Governance risk: Carvana disclosed leases and wholesale transactions with Garcia-controlled DriveTime as_of 2026-09-30; related-party economics warrant scrutiny.
Macro sensitivity: management estimated higher fuel prices and rising benchmark rates reduced Q3 unit economics by approximately $200 per unit, as_of 2026-09-30.

Legal diligence gap as_of 2026-11-10: a docket monitor records a class-certification order dated 2026-11-05 in the Carvana securities case. The ruling text and disposition were not obtained; neither continued pendency nor an adverse outcome should be assumed.

output.research_view: Analytical view as_of 2026-11-10: I would underwrite Carvana on sustainable unit economics and funding access, not headline revenue growth alone. Before sizing a position, prioritize independent inventory and loan-sale checks, related-party transaction economics, and verification of the latest class-certification disposition.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
